question: Should OpenClaw add a persisted `tools.exec.shell` override, and what exact shell/args, WSL cwd/PATH, validation, gateway/node/sandbox/PTY, approval, and safe-bin contract should it use?
rationale: The requested config knob changes the command execution boundary and cannot be safely designed from the feature request alone without maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Approve a scoped design first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a maintainer-owned design for the shell override contract before any implementation PR lands.

options.title: Reject arbitrary shell override
options.body: Close the broad config request later and keep solving concrete Windows shell bugs through narrower default-resolution fixes.

options.title: Allow a limited experimental knob
options.body: Permit only an opt-in trusted-gateway shell override with validation and documented unsupported WSL semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve a scoped design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a maintainer-owned design for the shell override contract before any implementation PR lands.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal across shell selection, exec config, docs, and adjacent approval hardening points to this account for the product/security decision.
